title: In an abstract monoid, the identity element is unique
statement: For any monoid record M (an abstract carrier, binary op, identity e, associativity, and two-sided identity laws) and any e' of M's carrier, if op a e' = a for every a, then e' = e.

formal.statement: theorem Alg.monoidIdentUnique : ((x0 : Alg.Monoid) -> ((x1 : Alg.Monoid.carrier x0) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : Alg.Monoid.carrier x0) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.Monoid.carrier x0) (Alg.Monoid.op x0 x2 x1) x2)) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.Monoid.carrier x0) x1 (Alg.Monoid.e x0))))

evidence.supports: Alg.monoidIdentUnique admits through the trusted kernel gate and, applied at TWO CONCRETE Alg.Monoid instances built from already-proved lemma constants ((Nat, add, 0) and (Rat, mul, 1), with genuine numeral witnesses e' := 0 / e' := 1 and existing lemmas Nat.add_zero / Rat.mul_one as the hypothesis), type-checks to Eq Nat 0 0 and Eq Rat 1 1 respectively -- the concrete half of docs/contributor-guide/kernel-proof-engineering.md's 'instantiate concretely AND check symbolically' discipline; the generic (symbolic M/e'/h) statement above is the symbolic half.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- monoid_ident_unique_applies_concretely_at_nat_add_and_rat_mul --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pattern is anchored on cargo's own pass/fail summary line with BOTH counts pinned ('1 passed; 0 failed'), so a panic (a TypeMismatch from the kernel, or an assertion failure) changes both numbers and the pattern stops matching. The FIRST version of this test failed with exactly this mechanism: it applied the theorem to the Alg.CommMonoid instances rather than genuine Alg.Monoid values -- this spine has no inheritance, so a CommMonoid-typed term does not apply where a Monoid is expected, and the kernel correctly refused it (TypeMismatch) until the test built real Monoid values from the same underlying lemma constants.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel build_rat_prelude, lane structures-1, ADR-1578 -- proved once over the abstract Alg.Monoid record and instantiated at two independently-built carriers.

notes: Proved over Alg.Monoid, not Alg.CommMonoid -- commutativity is never used (the proof needs only the LEFT identity law applied at e' and the hypothesis applied at M.e, matching Nat.IsGroupOn's Nat.group_identity_unique shape, nat_prelude/group.rs). Does NOT say the identity is unique in a semigroup without an identity law, or that Alg.Monoid has any relation (inheritance/coercion) to Alg.CommMonoid -- ADR-1578's spine has neither.
